newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX JGB, Euroyen may fall further after tankan.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX JGB, Euroyen may fall further after tankan.

text.p: SIMEX Japanese government bond (JGB) and Euroyen futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday after a better-than expected tankan report and dealers said both contracts might fall further before stabilising.
"I think this is only a temporary bottom," said a futures trader with a large European bank. "The market has still not absorbed the full decline."
The Japanese futures contracts fell after the long-waited tankan report from the Bank of Japan (BOJ) showed confidence in several key sectors of Japanese industry was far stronger than expected.
"JGBs could lose another 30 points to, say, 122.80, and the December Euroyen could get down to 98.90 before finding real support," said another.
Eurodollar futures followed the lower trend set by Euroyen but on much lower volume. September Eurodollars closed at 94.135 against their IMM close at 94.14 on volume of 4,595 lots.
